THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
GLOSSARY
004
A LANGUAGE FOR LOOKING
GLOSSARY / 2 OF 2
Mock-neck
A short, upright collar that covers part of the neck,
usually lower than a folded turtleneck.
A-line
A silhouette that widens from a narrower upper
section toward the hem, resembling the outline of the
letter A.
Ruched
Fabric gathered into repeated small folds to create
texture, shape or a close fit.
Ribbed knit
Knitted fabric with alternating raised and recessed
vertical rows, creating a ridged texture and stretch.
Cable knit
Knitwear in which groups of stitches cross to form
raised, rope-like patterns.
Satin
A fabric structure with a smooth, lustrous face that
catches light. Satin can be made from different fibers.
Velvet
Fabric with a dense, short pile that creates a soft
surface and changes its appearance with the direction
of light.
Tweed
A textured woven fabric commonly associated with
wool, mottled colors and structured tailoring.
Halter
A neckline or top supported around the neck, typically
leaving the shoulders and much of the upper back
open.
Jabot
A decorative arrangement of lace or ruffles worn at
the front of the neck or upper chest.
Faux fur
A manufactured material designed to resemble the
texture and appearance of animal fur.
Pleated
Fabric arranged into intentional folds, which can give
a garment structure, volume or movement.
